meta.definition: PolyXOR128 (Orson Peters), crate polyxor 0.1.0 (commit 3123eb6, zlib license), https://github.com/orlp/polyxor; 128-bit output

registrations.polyxor-128: hasher(); update(bytes); finalize_avalanche() (the crate's documented default output, a bijection of finalize_raw), 16 little-endian bytes; the table row

meta.key_model: PolyXor128::from_entropy of 4160 uniformly random bytes; the harness expands the 64-bit SMHasher3 seed with SplitMix64 into those 4160 bytes in seedfn, outside the timed calls (as for ChainHash-128); key setup is not timed

verification_values.note: SMHasher3 CE verification codes of this registration (identical on x86-64 and arm64); computed by SMHasher3 with the value set to 0, then fixed; Sanity PASS on both hosts

backend.Xeon8375C: arch=x86_64 backend=hash_blocks_avx512 (compile-time) compile_time=[("avx512f", true), ("avx512vl", true), ("vpclmulqdq", true), ("avx2", true), ("pclmulqdq", true)] runtime=[("avx512f", true), ("avx512vl", true), ("vpclmulqdq", true), ("avx2", true), ("pclmulqdq", true)]
backend.M2Pro: arch=aarch64 backend=neon::hash_blocks (compile-time) compile_time=[("neon", true), ("aes", true)] runtime=[("neon", true), ("aes", true)]
backend.note: with RUSTFLAGS=-C target-cpu=native the crate selects its backend at compile time: hash_blocks_avx512 (AVX-512F/VL + VPCLMULQDQ) on the Xeon, neon::hash_blocks (NEON + AES/PMULL) on the M2

affinity.Xeon8375C: nice -n 10 taskset -c 16-23 (the post's range; per-CPU busy samples of 16-23 in each run record)

Xeon8375C.note: shared host (~40/96 load from other users' unpinned jobs); one timing job at a time

protocol.bulk: Average of alignments 0..7 at fixed 262144 bytes (SMHasher3 Average line)
protocol.small: Average of the 31 separately measured 1..31-byte costs
protocol.xeon: two complete passes; higher fixed-size bulk (ties: higher GiB/s, then earlier) and lower small average (ties: earlier) selected independently
protocol.m2: three complete passes; median of bulk and median of small, independently; any run deviating more than 15 percent from its median is flagged, never dropped

Xeon8375C.rust_profile: release, lto=true, codegen-units=1, panic=abort; polyxor default features (aes, std, runtime_detection)
Xeon8375C.backend_probe: arch=x86_64 backend=hash_blocks_avx512 (compile-time) compile_time=[("avx512f", true), ("avx512vl", true), ("vpclmulqdq", true), ("avx2", true), ("pclmulqdq", true)] runtime=[("avx512f", true), ("avx512vl", true), ("vpclmulqdq", true), ("avx2", true), ("pclmulqdq", true)]
Xeon8375C.base: the post's Xeon SMHasher3 Release build (build-release-20260917, binary sha256 03c2ff9f38cc564400eeb1906da90cb74ea6efcff2bea6c660626fdbe1571a99); main.cpp.o and both libraries are the same objects the ChainHash-128 lane reused

M2Pro.rust_profile: release, lto=true, codegen-units=1, panic=abort; polyxor default features (aes, std, runtime_detection)
M2Pro.backend_probe: arch=aarch64 backend=neon::hash_blocks (compile-time) compile_time=[("neon", true), ("aes", true)] runtime=[("neon", true), ("aes", true)]

The post's M2 base (m2-rerun/build-fixed, binary fb2f75fb...) no longer exists on disk; controls here are same-binary, so polyxor is compared against them rather than against the chart's older M2 cells
